static_findings.message: An input-derived redirect target is returned after its parsed host or scheme was inspected; verify backslash and control-character forms.

security_requirements: The returned location, resolved by a browser on https://shop.example, must not lead to another host or a non-http scheme.
label: not_vulnerable
reason: Rejects backslashes and control characters, requires host shop.example with no port or userinfo, and returns a path that cannot start with // or /\.
how_checked: code review + 33 payloads resolved with the WHATWG URL parser (Node)
